L.audio_profile: A cheerful woman of 25 with a bright, warm, quick voice; sitting still in a silent tennis crowd, speaking very low and close to her phone, almost whispering, the words still clear; natural and unpolished, like a friend filming a vlog.

T.audio_profile: A tall, calm man of 30 with a low, dry, casual voice; slow, proud, deadpan; speaking very low, almost whispering, so that the people around do not hear; he never raises his voice.

dialogue_turns.text: [very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, thrilled] We're at the tennis.
[very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, a warning] Don't open that.
[very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, pleading] I'm starving.
[very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, firm] Wait for the clapping.
[very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, as if it is a perfectly reasonable plan] I'll do it really slowly.
[very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, urgent] Luna, no—
[after a pause, very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, flat, to nobody] I'm not with her.
[very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, indignant] We have the same scarf.
[very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, flat and final] Coincidence.

payload.scene: A phone vlog from the top row of an outdoor tennis stand on a still, sunny afternoon, in the hush while a point is played: a thousand people sit silent and a ball is hit far below. Luna holds the phone at arm's length and whispers to it, a packet of crisps in her other hand; Timo stands just behind her and whispers too.
payload.sample_context: A twenty-second comedy sketch played by two close friends who bicker. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. Both speak very low, close to the phone, almost whispering, because the whole stand is silent during play; every word stays clear. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful and quick; she is hungry, and to her opening the packet very slowly is a perfectly reasonable plan; she is innocent, never sarcastic. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he knows exactly what will happen, and he never raises his voice. They answer each other fast, with no gaps between the lines.

text: We're at the tennis. Don't open that. I'm starving. Wait for the clapping. I'll do it really slowly. Luna, no. I'm not with her. We have the same scarf. Coincidence.
